column1: # Read automatically by gm_translate.py; entries whose Tibetan term occurs in
# a batch are added to that call's context as fixed terminology. Each line
# below answers a recurring error found in the 2026-09-06 pilot review
# (pilot-review.md §3 and §6). Keep entries to terms whose rendering is
# settled; this is not a place for style.
# མ་ལུས་ "without exception / without remainder" — the model rendered it
# мадаггүй ("flawless"), which is a different word.
# Seed syllables of the Tārā mantra (oṃ tāre tuttāre ture svāhā), which this
# corpus scatters through verse lines rather than giving as one mantra line.
# Attested Mongolian recitation form: Ум дарэ дүдарэ дүрэ суха.
# Proper names pinned by gm_names.py --propose (gemini-3.1-pro-preview); one spelling each.
# Added 2026-09-07 after the corpus spot-reads: a source spelling variant, the ཨེ་མ་ཧོ interjection, the Vajra Guru mantra.
